description: Defines the HtmlGenerator class responsible for generating an HTML report visualizing file access data, including styling, scripting for directory tree interaction, and debug info.

classes.name: HtmlGenerator
classes.description: Class providing static methods to generate HTML reports of directory trees and file access visualization.

methods.name: generate_html_report
methods.description: Creates an HTML report file visualizing directory structure and file access, with search and toggle features.

methods.name: get_last_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message encountered during report generation.
